facts.fact: IFAD states that on 7 May 2025 it and China's CIDCA signed the US$2.268 million SAT-CARE project, which will support Tanzania's Ministry of Agriculture in developing a satellite-based agricultural information system.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture (with IFAD and CIDCA)

TZA.note: The document states no rural connectivity programme or rural and urban internet use figures.
